limitations.note: The patch correctly registered the read port but also made out-of-range reads return zero, whereas the reference preserves the unknown result of indexing outside the RAM.
The test checked the intended clocked read timing, but its out-of-range case expected the newly introduced zero result, so it could not catch that behavior change.
